title: My team
directReportsHint: Employees whose manager or secondary manager is you.
noDirectory: Your role cannot open your reports' employee records, so the list stays hidden. Ask HR for a role with the employee.view_team permission (the Line Manager role has it) to see your reports here.
emptyHint: Nobody reports to your employee record yet. HR sets the manager and secondary manager on each employee profile.
notManagerHint: This page opens for members whose employee record is the manager or secondary manager of other employees.

today.emptyHint: Your reports appear here once their employee records are active.
today.noAttendanceKey: Your role cannot read your reports' attendance. Ask HR for a role with the attendance.view_team permission (the Line Manager role has it) to see today's board.

attendance.empty: No attendance records in this range
attendance.emptyHint: Records appear once punches arrive and the engine calculates the day.
attendance.readOnly: Read-only: requesting a correction needs the attendance.correct permission.

leave.upcomingHint: Approved and pending leave of your reports that ends today or later (at most 20).
leave.pendingForMe_one: {{count}} leave request is waiting for you
leave.pendingForMe_other: {{count}} leave requests are waiting for you
leave.emptyHint: Approved and pending leave of your reports appears here.

approvals.teamHint: View only: the {{count}} most recent requests of your direct reports. Decisions happen on the rows waiting for you.
approvals.requestsEmpty: No requests are waiting for you
approvals.requestsEmptyHint: Leave, corrections and other requests routed to you appear here.
approvals.teamEmpty: No requests from your team yet
approvals.more: {{count}} more waiting in the approvals inbox
approvals.reasonsHint: Reasons your reports gave for their days. You decide the ones waiting for you; rows seen through HR oversight are marked.
approvals.reasonsEmpty: No reasons are waiting for you
approvals.reasonsEmptyHint: When a report explains a late, absent or incomplete day, the reason appears here.
approvals.noTeamKey: Your role cannot list your team's requests (attendance.view_team or leave.view_team is needed).

delegation.title: Delegation
delegation.hint: While you are away, a delegate decides the requests routed to you. Delegations you create or receive are listed here.
